startMessage.line1: You like your partner—so why do you need alone time this much?
startMessage.line2: Even with someone you love, you want a solo weekend day. Texts keep coming and suddenly you just want to put the phone down. You don't dislike them—but saying "I need time alone" feels like it'll hurt them, so you feel guilty.
startMessage.line3: Needing alone time has different reasons for different people. Guarding your own space, battery that drains fast, emotions flooding in at once, anxiety when boundaries blur, or long relationship fatigue. Once you know why, how you explain it changes too.
startMessage.line4: Across ten situations, we'll show the real reason alone feels easier—and how to understand that independence need.
